# `forall`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Tests whether a predicate holds for all elements in the array.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
forall(expr, pred)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- forall, example 1
> SELECT forall(array(1, 2, 3), x -> x % 2 == 0);
false
```

```sql
-- forall, example 2
> SELECT forall(array(2, 4, 8), x -> x % 2 == 0);
true
```

```sql
-- forall, example 3
> SELECT forall(array(1, null, 3), x -> x % 2 == 0);
false
```

```sql
-- forall, example 4
> SELECT forall(array(2, null, 8), x -> x % 2 == 0);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
